d: Ugandan President Yoweri Museveni's plan to position his son, Muhoozi Kainerugaba, as his successor has reportedly hit a major roadblock, with senior members of the ruling National Resistance Movement (NRM) opposing the move. Reports suggest that 28 party members rejected Kainerugaba's candidacy, while only four backed him during a closed-door meeting. As the 81-year-old Museveni weighs his political future, his 52-year-old son has already expressed ambitions to contest the 2031 presidential election and announced plans to step down as Uganda's army chief.
